title: Checkout database pool exhaustion
root_cause: database connection pool exhaustion caused by leaked application connections
resolution: increased connection pool temporarily and deployed a fix for leaked connections
summary: Checkout requests became slow and began timing out. Database connection pool utilization reached 98% and application workers could not acquire new connections.

title: Expired authentication signing key
resolution: rotated the signing certificate and restarted authentication workers
summary: Users experienced widespread authentication failures. JWT validation failed and HTTP 401 responses increased sharply after the signing certificate expired.

title: Email processing backlog during campaign
root_cause: worker capacity was insufficient for a sudden increase in queued messages
resolution: scaled worker replicas and monitored queue depth until backlog cleared
summary: Email queue depth increased rapidly and workers remained fully occupied. Processing delay exceeded normal thresholds.

title: Third-party payment gateway degradation
root_cause: external payment provider experienced elevated latency
resolution: enabled provider failover and increased retry backoff
summary: Payment requests timed out and provider latency exceeded six seconds. Retry traffic increased significantly.

title: Recommendation worker memory leak
root_cause: memory leak in recommendation worker process
resolution: restarted affected workers and fixed object retention in application code
summary: Memory usage increased continuously until workers were terminated by out-of-memory protection.

title: Product API cache outage
resolution: restored previous cache configuration and restarted product API workers
summary: Product API returned elevated HTTP 500 errors after Redis connections began failing.

title: Order API regression after release
resolution: rolled back the release to the previous stable application version
summary: Order creation began failing immediately after a new deployment. Error rate increased above 70%.
